svg.title: DCS-IPIA visual assignment editor concept
svg.desc: A wireframe showing separate Module and UI Layer command palettes, graphical MFD3 controls, drag and drop from OSB13 to OSB3, right-click actions, occupied destination prompt, and settings for theme and replacement behavior.
svg.text: Drag a command, or right-click a control.
Drag OSB13 → OSB3; right-click either button for the same action.
Choose what happens to the existing OSB3 command:
Nothing is written until the reviewed draft is saved.
CONCEPT MOCKUP · illustrates intended interactions; current import preview remains read-only.
